nota: Tiempos exactos: la pista es la concatenación de los audios de cada segmento con pausas fijas.

segmentos.texto: Excuse me, how much is this jacket?
The blue one? It's seventy-nine ninety-nine.
Hmm, that's a bit expensive. Do you have it in black?
Yes, we do. What size are you?
Here you are. The fitting rooms are over there, on the right.
It's a little small. Do you have a large?
Sorry, we don't have any large ones in black. But this grey jacket is on sale today. It's only forty-five dollars.
Forty-five? Great! Can I try it on?
It's perfect. I'll take it. Can I pay by card?
